component.name: ScrollArea
component.description: A container that scrolls its content horizontally or vertically with native scrolling and no visible scrollbar.

useWhen: A row of cards or items should scroll horizontally without a visible scrollbar (touch and trackpad users can scroll naturally)
A content region has a fixed height and should scroll vertically with the native scrollbar hidden
You want a native-scroll carousel alternative to the JS-animated useCarousel + transform pattern

notFor.case: Using ScrollArea as the clip container for a JS transform-based carousel
notFor.because: ScrollArea sets overflow: auto — the scroll position will shift as the transform moves the track, producing broken behaviour.
notFor.note: Use a plain div with overflow: hidden as the clip container for transform-based carousels.

useWhen.horizontal: A row of cards that scrolls sideways; put an Inline with wrap=false inside.
useWhen.vertical: A fixed-height region whose list scrolls; put a Stack inside.

donts.case: Placing a block-level Inline inside ScrollArea without width: max-content
donts.because: Block-level flex containers are constrained to their parent's width by the browser. Inside overflow-x: auto the browser squeezes items rather than creating scroll, causing cards to shrink and titles to wrap unexpectedly.
donts.instead: Always pass style={{ width: 'max-content' }} to Inline when it is the direct child of a horizontal ScrollArea.

patterns.name: native-scroll-carousel
patterns.useWhen: A horizontally overflowing row that scrolls natively without arrows, e.g. on touch.

patterns.name: scrollable-list
patterns.useWhen: A list longer than its fixed-height region, scrolled inside the region.
